h1: Laravel 11 Starter with Pest, Pint, PHPStan, Sail & Docker
includes: Pest 3 + Pest Laravel plugin (parallel testing, coverage)
PHPStan level 5 with Larastan for static analysis
Laravel Sail for local Docker development
FrankenPHP Dockerfile (worker mode, Octane-compatible) for production
GitHub Actions: pint → phpstan → pest → build
Generated README with Sail commands and deployment guide

faq.q: Does this work with Laravel Octane?
faq.a: The template uses FrankenPHP worker mode which is Octane-compatible. For full Octane, add `laravel/octane` and configure RoadRunner/Swoole.

faq.q: Can I use this with Laravel Forge/Vapor?
faq.a: Yes. The generated project is a standard Laravel 11 app compatible with Forge, Vapor, and any Laravel hosting.
PHP 8.2+ (Laravel 11 requirement). The Dockerfile uses PHP 8.3 with FrankenPHP.

faq.q: Does it include Laravel Breeze / Jetstream?
faq.a: No — the template is a clean API base. Install Breeze/Jetstream after generation if you need auth scaffolding.
